project_info.theme: Close-up packaging callout for recycled PET bottle material

items: Top Left: Black bottle cap cropped close to the top edge.
Top Right: Cute blue butterfly doodle and a short yellow squiggle accent over blurred sky.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a close-up packaging callout about recycled PET bottle material. Centerpiece is a bottle-shaped paper tag reading 'CHAI LÀM TỪ NHỰA PET TÁI CHẾ 100% GIẢM NHỰA NGUYÊN SINH' attached to the top of a pink Cocoon bottle. Background is soft outdoor sky and green bokeh. Surrounding elements: partial Cocoon branding, a black cap crop, and a cute blue butterfly doodle with a yellow squiggle. Keep the macro crop, readable paper texture, and friendly sustainability look. Technical style: high fidelity macro product photography with doodle overlay, soft outdoor daylight, gentle bokeh and crisp paper texture, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
